statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology
The patient has a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is to capture intermittent cardiac events
The service is to assess for potential atrial or ventricular arrhythmias
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I34.0
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
